# LogiCade world-to-curriculum map

Status: Little Loop Farm and Three Lanes, One Kingdom are playable farming and strategy-defense examples. The remaining themed collection contains puzzle prototypes, not finished genre games. The strategy example adapts Tower Defense Logic variation 1: a three-lane village defense.

Two genre prototypes now run real farming and tower-defense loops. The 50 themes and their ten variations each remain documented references.

50 themes × 10 authored CP1 labs = 500 puzzle chapters. Each topic and challenge appears exactly once. The worlds use 13 visual directions and 12 CP1 gameplay mechanics. Weeks 9–14 remain explicitly labeled as the finals extension.

The existing puzzle runtime works as follows: ordering builds the traversable program, wiring creates routes, assignments change world values, classification routes objects, and stepping advances the authored machine state. The world renders the learner’s actual choices. Run executes those choices and stops at an invalid operation. There is no independent arcade objective or subsequent lesson screen. Demonstrations do not award mastery. Prompts, answers and explanations remain in data/cp1/challenges/.
